Class ElementCollection

java.lang.Object
model.ElementCollection
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Element>
Direct Known Subclasses:
Tier
public class ElementCollection extends Object implements Iterable<Element>
Aggregation of Element instances, is Iterable. Wrapper class for a List of Element , it's provided with wrappers for List methods and additional useful functions. It's main purpose is to be inherited by Tier
